decisions.note: Require takeover-specific knowledge and a mark scheme that accepts valid takeover-specific explanation routes; deepen the Foundation first so the question is supported by approved teaching.

Remove the answer-giving synergy wording from the scenario and require the learner to identify and explain the synergy mechanism; deepen the Foundation first with an explicit synergy definition and mechanisms.
Add crisis-management teaching to BUS-STR-009, then regenerate and review the dependent question rather than removing the examinable item.
Deepen the Foundation node actually mapped to relationship between mission and objectives / why businesses set objectives, then regenerate and freshly review q20.
Regenerate q24 so it genuinely assesses social-enterprise knowledge and limited/unlimited liability, and make the mark scheme credit valid reasons that answer the question.
Regenerate q25 with a mark scheme broad enough to credit valid shareholder-return reasons for investing and other valid explanation routes supported by the teaching.
Deepen BUS-FND-009 with explicit environmental-issues teaching and business-effect mechanisms, then regenerate and freshly review q38.
Regenerate q41 so the scenario does not give away the role of regulators and the learner must supply the target knowledge.
Add environmental-objectives teaching to BUS-OPS-001, the node actually mapped to the item, then regenerate and freshly review q01.
Regenerate q04 so emerging-economy knowledge is necessary to answer and align the marking points to the requested explanation of one opportunity.
Regenerate q05 without describing the licensing arrangement so explicitly that the target route is given away in the scenario.
Regenerate q07 so multinational knowledge is genuinely assessed and the mark scheme does not reward merely repeating a fact supplied by the question.
Deepen BUS-STR-009 with explicit Lewin force-field analysis teaching, including driving and restraining forces, then regenerate and freshly review q10.
